# AROFi — WiFi Hotspot Billing & Mobile Money System
# llms.txt — Machine-readable summary for AI assistants and LLM crawlers

> AROFi is Uganda's #1 cloud-based WiFi hotspot billing and management platform,
> built by AROSOFT Innovations Ltd (Kampala, Uganda).
> It lets MikroTik router operators, ISPs, hotels, schools, and community
> networks collect payments via MTN Mobile Money and Airtel Money, manage
> vouchers, track sessions, and control routers — all from one dashboard.

## Key Information

- **Website**: https://arofi.net
- **Company**: AROSOFT Innovations Ltd, Kampala, Uganda
- **Support**: support@arofi.net | +256 787 726 388
- **Category**: WiFi Hotspot Billing Software / SaaS
- **Geography**: Uganda, East Africa
- **Primary language**: English

## Core Capabilities

- MikroTik RADIUS authentication and captive portal billing
- MTN Mobile Money (MoMo) and Airtel Money payment collection
- Multi-tenant SaaS — each operator gets an isolated business workspace
- WiFi voucher generation and management
- Real-time session tracking and router fleet management
- Remote MikroTik router access via secure VPN tunnel (Cloud WinBox)
- Automated mobile money collection and instant withdrawals
- QR code scan-and-pay for hotspot access

## Pricing (UGX)

| Plan       | Monthly Fee | MoMo Commission | Voucher Commission | Routers |
|------------|-------------|-----------------|-------------------|---------|
| Starter    | Free        | 8%              | 2%                | Up to 5 |
| Pro        | 20,000 UGX  | 5%              | 0%                | Up to 10 |
| Enterprise | 70,000 UGX  | 2%              | 0%                | Unlimited |
